ops.title: Bump write-like-me's spawnllm dependency to >=0.6.2
ops.description: In /Users/yasyf/Code/write-like-me: raise the `lab` extra floor from spawnllm>=0.5.5 to >=0.6.2 so its in-progress codex lab code picks up the service_tier=fast pin. Repo is on a detached HEAD with dirty .claude/settings.json — stash-dance to main, commit ONLY pyproject.toml + uv.lock, run uv with `env -u UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER`. Blocked on the 0.6.2 PyPI release being live.

ops.text: write-like-me main has a commit raising the lab extra to spawnllm>=0.6.2 with a clean uv.lock diff (no [options] exclude-newer block)
uv run python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('spawnllm'))" in write-like-me prints 0.6.2 and CodexCliBackend argv contains service_tier=fast
